Overview

Grand Junction is a city in CO with a population of 65,000. Western Slope hub with Colorado National Monument, wine country, and outdoor access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
